Several sessions (includes hunting for rare items and 4 bosses)

Follow in the footsteps of the old knight Galthen in three missions. In **Bounac** you find out what happened to Queen Yselda, wife of King {npc:Kesar the Younger}, and face {creature:Megasylvan Yselda}. Then you find the lost city of **Iksupan**, in Tiquanda, defeat {creature:Ahau} and, deeper down, {creature:Atab} and the {creature:Mitmah Vanguard}. You receive the {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits}, the {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits} (with addons) and three achievements.
Kesar the Younger's wife, Yselda, has been taken from him. Will you help him investigate the dark forces that took part in this malicious ploy?
Kesar the Younger, Bounac throne room

{npc:Kesar the Younger} only appears in the throne room when it is **day** in Tibia. If you can't find him, wait for daytime.
Gather the soup ingredients (20 {item:Carnisylvan Finger}, 10 {item:Carnisylvan Bark}, 2 {item:Human Teeth}) before going down to the Forest of Life.

1. Galthen and the Lost Queen — investigation in Bounac
The king of Bounac has lost his wife, Yselda. You will hear the story from several NPCs and find the traces of the knight Galthen.

Bounac is on an island between Thais and Meriana. To get there, go to **Edron** and look for the small boat **north** of the mountain pass (marked spot): that is how you travel to Bounac. You need level **250** to enter.
To return from Bounac to the mainland, go back to Edron on the same boat you arrived on.
Go up to the throne room

Inside Bounac, go up to the **3rd floor** by the stairs where {npc:Onfroi} stands during the day, head **north** and then **west** to the {npc:Bounac Guard} and say {key:hi}, {key:pass}, {key:yes}. Go up **2 more floors**: you arrive at the throne room.

To leave the castle, go down to the floor below the throne room, follow the ramp **south** and enter the elevator. After you have used it once, that elevator also serves as a shortcut back into the castle.

Go to **Bounac** and go up to the throne room, where {npc:Kesar the Younger} is (he only appears during the **day**). Say {key:hi} and {key:yselda}; then answer anything. He tells you his wife was taken from him and that the seer Lesh showed him her fate.
Look for {npc:Lesh the Seer} in Bounac (1 floor above ground) and say {key:hi} and {key:yselda}. He tells you about the knight Galthen, who left Bounac for Edron to seek advice from the mages.

Go back to **Edron** on the Bounac boat and go to the Magic Academy. Talk to {npc:Spectulus}: {key:hi}, {key:yselda} and {key:yes}. He explains Yselda's curse and tells you to follow Galthen's steps in Bounac.

Go back to Bounac on the small boat north of Edron's mountain pass. In the **south** part of the city, walk **west** to a house where {npc:An Idol} is. Use the ritual notes on the floor in front of it. You get the message: *"Staring at the writing you begin to decipher a letter. Then another and another. The symbols seem to wriggle and move: VBOX"*.
An Idol and the notes on the floor in front of it
Greet {npc:An Idol} by saying {key:VBOX} (it means 'Death' in Jekhr). You are teleported to a small cave.

Inside the cave keep walking **south** until you find a dead tree. Use it to receive {item:Galthen's Satchel}, with an {item:Artefact Box} and a {item:Parchment} inside (Galthen's old notes about the disappearance of a woman in Bounac). After a few seconds you are teleported out automatically.
The dead tree where Galthen's satchel is
Galthen's Satchel with Artefact Box and Parchment
You can take a new {item:Galthen's Satchel} from this tree every **30 days**.

**Northeast** of An Idol is {npc:Innkeeper Alphonse}. Ask him about **Galthen** ({key:galthen}; in the recorded dialogue the word {key:yselda} was used) and answer {key:yes} to all the questions (three times). At the end he gives you the old knight's {item:Ritual Notes}.
Go back to the throne room and say {key:hi} and {key:yselda} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He gives you access to the **Bounacean Lion**, a sealed cave beneath the castle.
Go through the gate (1 floor below ground) to enter the **Bounacean Lion** dungeon. Go down the stairs, head **southwest** and go down again.
The cave is full of {creature:Crypt Warrior|Crypt Warriors}.
Go around the cave until you reach the **Sulphur Pool** (floor -3). When you step into it you are teleported to the **Forest of Life**.
The shortcut between the Forest of Life and the surface only becomes available after you beat Yselda (see "Shortcut to the surface", further down).
The Sulphur Pool that takes you to the Forest of Life

In the Forest of Life go down to the **lowest floor** and go to the far end to the **southeast**, where the {item:Soup Kettle} is. Use on it, one by one, the 20 {item:Carnisylvan Finger|Carnisylvan Fingers}, the 10 {item:Carnisylvan Bark|Carnisylvan Barks} and the 2 {item:Human Teeth}. Then use the Kettle itself.
The Soup Kettle at the bottom of the Forest of Life
Soup ready after using the ingredients and the Kettle

From the Kettle go to the big room next to it and use {spell:Levitate} to climb the ramp. Head **south** and walk along the trees: you are teleported to a small room, where {creature:Megasylvan Yselda} is. You can enter with a team of **up to 5 players**.

There are two possible endings:
- **Simple method:** you kill Yselda and let the **Megasylvan Saplings** die (there are four, one in each corner). You complete part of the quest (outfit and achievement).
- **Healing method:** you keep all **four Saplings alive throughout the fight**. Only then do you also receive the {item:Violet Tulip} and the first addon.
Kill Yselda; the Saplings may die
Keep healing the 4 Saplings until Yselda dies
Violet Tulip + access to the first addon (John)
For Yselda to be hurt, say the words {key:DEMIHBOULDR}, {key:SOMMBHA} and {key:WITHER} in **NPC Chat** or **Local Chat**.
These are the ritual words: type them exactly like this.

To save the Saplings go with a full team of 5, with as many mages as possible. Each player should bring at least 100 {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}. The Saplings constantly take around **1000 damage** during almost the whole fight, so they have to be healed non-stop. Put the best healers (mages) on the **south** Saplings; the rest alternate between attacking Yselda and healing the **north** Saplings.
Everyone should attack Yselda a few times to get participation and loot.
If a Sapling dies, you can no longer get the full ending (Violet Tulip and addon).

After the fight say {key:hi} to {npc:Yselda}, now in NPC form. The dialogue changes depending on the method you used. You receive the **Woodcarver** achievement. Leave the room through the teleport (a little hidden) to the **south**.

From now on you can use a shortcut between the Forest of Life and the surface. It is **1 floor above** the exit of Yselda's room. Use it to leave the forest and return to Bounac; it also lets you come back down later.

Return to the surface and say {key:hi} and {key:yselda} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. You receive the {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits}. If you saved the Saplings, he also gives you a {item:Violet Tulip} (he asks you to take it to Yselda) and authorises you to talk to {npc:John (Bounac)}, the carpenter.
Only if you saved the Saplings: go to {npc:John (Bounac)}, Bounac's carpenter, and tell him Kesar sent you. He gives you the **first addon** of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits.
First addon of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits
Galthen also explored an ancient lost city called Iksupan. To enter it you need to assemble a disc-shaped key from three pieces.
Find the Writ in the Tiquanda ruins

Go to **Tiquanda** (Port Hope jungle): take a boat to Port Hope (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the jungle **southeast** of the city to the ruins on the map. Walk next to the Writ in the ruins. You get the message *"A sign reads: 'Sealed by the Inquisition at official behest of Chaplain Sandomo'"* and the Quest Log is updated.
The Writ in the Tiquanda ruins

Go to **Roshamuul**: in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes}, 210 gp). The boat docks at Lower Roshamuul, next to the Inquisition camp, where you talk to {npc:Sandomo}. Say {key:hi}, {key:door}, {key:yes}, {key:grandfather}, {key:key} and {key:diary}. You receive a {item:Piece of an Ancient Disc} and a {item:Crumbled Diary Page}.
To leave Roshamuul, talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, by the Inquisition boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp).

Use the {item:Crumbled Diary Page}. The locations of the other two disc pieces are marked on your map: *"You add the specific locations of the last known whereabouts of each piece from the diary to your map."*

Go to the island of **Folda**, west of Carlin: talk to the ferryman {npc:Nielson}, northwest of Carlin, and say {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You arrive at the Folda dock. Go down into the dungeon (main entrance inside the mountain or the hole in the ice south of the mountain) and keep heading **east** to the spot on the map (floor -1). Use a {item:Pick} (or equivalent) between the two ornate floors covered in rubble and go down the hole.
Nielson (boat to Folda, northwest of Carlin)
The spot where the disc piece is
Down there, open the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|Pile of Bones} to receive the {item:Fragment of an Ancient Disc}.

Return to the surface the same way you came down (bring a {item:Rope} to climb out of the holes) and go back to the dock. Talk to {npc:Svenson}: {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}. The trip back to the mainland is free.

Take the 5 {item:Nail|Nails} with you and go to **Oramond**: in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp); from {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft use the {item:Slime Slide}, go down from the hill, walk east to the portal on the small boat and continue to Rathleton. From Rathleton cross the Workshops to the **east** and go past the entrance hill of the {wiki:Oramond Minotaur Camp|Oramond Minotaur Camp}. Go to the minotaur camp in the **northeast**, climb the ramp in the centre of the camp, go up one more floor, head **south** and go down twice until you reach the marked spot.
Entrance hill of the Oramond Minotaur Camp
Ramp in the centre of the camp

1. Use the {item:Crate} to receive {item:Wet Boards}.
2. With the 5 {item:Nail|Nails} in your inventory, use the Wet Boards to build a raft (you don't receive a new item): *"With a few nails you manage to build a fragile little raft. [...]"*
3. Use the {item:Sturdy Bollard} **south** of you to travel to a small island nearby.
On the island, use the dragon skeleton to receive the {item:Part of an Ancient Disc}.
Dragon skeleton (Part of an Ancient Disc)

The wiki doesn't describe how to leave the islet: go back to the spot where the raft dropped you and return from there next to the {item:Sturdy Bollard}. Then retrace your path through the minotaur camp (ramps and entrance hill) to Rathleton. To leave Oramond, go back to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
Sturdy Bollard (where you set off on the raft)
With the three pieces in your inventory, combine any two of them to create {item:The Key Intihuatac}.

If you lose the key: say {key:lost} to {npc:Sandomo} to receive another {item:Piece of an Ancient Disc}, pick up the Fragment again from the Pile of Bones in Folda and the Part from the dragon skeleton in Oramond (coordinates above) and put them together again.
Go back to the Tiquanda ruins where you started (southeast of Port Hope, through the jungle) and use {item:The Key Intihuatac} on the inscriptions. You enter the secret city of gold, **Iksupan**.

Find the way to the **third floor** of Iksupan and keep heading **north**. You pass through an area of lava with walkable stones until you reach a room with **two blue flames**. The **north** flame leads to the lever room, where you start the fight with a team of **up to 5 players**.
On the third floor there is walkable lava that takes health **proportional to your maximum health**. Don't move by map-click and pay attention to the path.

If you have {item:Daedal Chisel|Daedal Chisels} (rare loot from {creature:Iks Ahpututu}), use them to break the amphorae in the room at the start of the fight. Each amphora corresponds to one of Ahau's extra lives.
The Chisels are rare and the fight isn't complicated: doing it without them is no problem.

At the start {creature:Ahau} is accompanied by two {creature:Cursed Ape|Cursed Apes}. Kill the boss in the **middle of the room** (you can trap him next to the throne). When he is almost dead, he heals fully, **explodes for 500 earth damage** and summons another Cursed Ape. Lava streams also appear on the left and right sides of the room, so stay in the **centre**. This repeats, with the lava growing, until you kill him for the **fourth time**.
Stay away from the lava streams at the sides; the danger zone grows with each Ahau 'death'.
Use the idol and receive the outfit
The first time you defeat Ahau you receive {item:The Living Idol of Tukh}. Use the idol to receive the {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits}.

To leave, use the shortcut just **east** of the blue flames: the {item:Slab with a Skull} teleports you back to the entrance, in the Tiquanda ruins. From there, walk back through the jungle **northwest** to Port Hope, where you can catch a boat.
The four Mitmah keys (East, South, West and North) have no fixed order: the order below is just a suggestion.

After defeating Ahau, talk to the ghost {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}, who is outside Ahau's lever room. Accept his help with {key:yes}. You can now use the {wiki:Spheric Teleporter|spheric teleporter} in that room, which takes you near the underground city.
Go down to Iksupan Last Stand
Follow the corridor and go up the stairs to a tomb with an opening to the **east**. Go down the hole to reach **Iksupan Last Stand**.

The creatures here are stronger: {creature:Iks Yapunac|Iks Yapunacs}, {creature:Mitmah Seer|Mitmah Seers} and {creature:Mitmah Scout|Mitmah Scouts} appear from here on. Use this first area to get used to them.

Find the way to the corridor that leads to the **north** area and the stairs to the floor below. The floor has **spike traps**: each time you step on one, a counter next to your character's name goes down. If it reaches **zero**, you are teleported back to the start and have to try again.
With the **first addon** of the Ancient Aucar Outfits the counter starts at **99**; without it, it starts at **3**. Reaching zero has no other penalty besides sending you back to the start.

Go to the boss {creature:Atab}. Defeating him for the first time gives you {item:The Mitmah East Key}. Try to deal **most of the damage**: that gives you access to a sealed room to the **northwest** on the same floor (you need it for the next key).
If you have the first addon of the Ancient Aucar Outfits, you may be teleported to an arena for a more isolated fight with the boss.
South key: finding the right chest

The second key is in a chest, but the contents can move between chests. There are **three possible chests**: one closer to the underground entrance, one to the **southeast** of Atab's arena and one in the **sealed room to the northwest** (you only get into this one if you killed Atab and dealt most of the damage). Check them until you find the right one and use it to receive {item:The Mitmah South Key}.

Go to another spheric teleporter that takes you to the pipe hub ({wiki:Iksupan Waterways|Iksupan Waterways}). You can either walk **north**, past the {wiki:Enormous Statue of Tukh|Enormous Statue of Tukh}, and follow the path **east** to the teleporter, or use {spell:Levitate} to go up a shorter shortcut (one of the points marked on the map).

In the main room there are levers that give you access to the door in the same direction (e.g. the south lever opens the south door). Use one, run down the corridor in that direction and use the lever at the end to repair the pipe. Repeat for all **four directions** (north, south, east and west), in whatever order you like; you can switch between options whenever you need. At the end the message *"All pipelines active, something very large down below rumbles and shifts."* appears.
Waterworks hub (main room with the levers)
You now have access to this room. Use the ornate box to receive {item:The Mitmah West Key}.

Go **north** from the main room and go down the stairs (1 floor). Near the stairs there is an empty bucket next to a lizard statue. Use an {item:Ancient Iks Ritual Chalice} (very rare loot from {creature:Iks Yapunac|Iks Yapunacs}) on the bucket: this starts a ritual that summons several {creature:Ancient Ugly Monster|Ancient Ugly Monsters} and a **Ritualwater**.

Push the Ritualwater **north**, cross the bridge and take it to one of the two {wiki:Empty Basin|Empty Basins} (one to the **west**, the other to the **east**). When it arrives, the ritual is complete, all the Ancient Ugly Monsters turn into {creature:Cursed Ape|Cursed Apes} and you gain access to the gates to the **north**.
You have **5 minutes** to bring the Ritualwater to a basin. If you fail, you need another {item:Ancient Iks Ritual Chalice}.

Go through the gates and use the barrel to receive {item:Pilchi with Paint}. You also need a {item:Ceremonial Brush} (rare loot from {creature:Mitmah Seer|Mitmah Seers} and {creature:Mitmah Vanguard|Mitmah Vanguards}).

With the {item:Pilchi with Paint} and the {item:Ceremonial Brush}, consecrate **3 doors** in the Iksupan area. There are doors both underground and on the levels closer to the entrance; a good suggestion is the corridor just **west** of the {wiki:Enormous Statue of Tukh|Enormous Statue of Tukh}.
Example of a door being consecrated
Consecrating the third and last door
After consecrating the doors you have access to a new room. Open the skeleton to receive {item:The Mitmah North Key}.
With all **four keys** in your inventory, continue **north** and use the {wiki:Monumental Gate|Monumental Gate} to reach the final area.
The {creature:Mitmah Vanguard} is the final boss of this part. It is not complex, but its **energy UE** does a lot of damage. Equip as much **energy** protection as you can.

A knight should hold the boss and the creatures with {spell:Challenge} ({spell:Chivalrous Challenge} does not work in boss rooms, so you can't do anything about the {creature:Mitmah Scout}). The others attack from range.

When the boss shouts *"FEAR THE CURSE!"*, it **roots** players in a large radius, teleports to a random spot in the room and casts an energy UE for about **6000 damage**. If you think you won't survive if it appears near you, equip a {item:Shockwave Amulet} and/or an {item:Energy Ring} right away and use {spell:Magic Shield} and {spell:Protector}.
The boss's teleports always go to the same preset spots: some parts of the room are always safe. Use that to position yourself and guide your team.
When the boss shouts *"NOW TREMBLE!"* another energy UE comes, this time **with no root and no teleport**. Watch your health and get ready.
Keep dealing damage until the boss dies. At the end of the fight you receive the achievement **Museum Goer** and the **second addon** of the {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits}.
Ancient Aucar (male) with the second addon
Ancient Aucar (female) with the second addon
Second addon of the Ancient Aucar Outfits + Museum Goer achievement

The wiki does not describe an exit shortcut from the Mitmah Vanguard area. Go back the way you came to the **blue flames** area on the third floor of Iksupan and use the {item:Slab with a Skull}, just **east** of them, to be teleported to the entrance in the Tiquanda ruins. From there, walk to Port Hope.
If the way back goes through the spike traps or the lava on the third floor, do not travel by map-click.
This quest is also known as the **City of Gold Quest**.
The mission Galthen and the Lost Queen came out first; Galthen and the City of Gold arrived with the Winter Update 2022 and Part II with the Winter Update 2023.
Part II gives two achievements: **Warrior of the Iks** and **Museum Goer**.
